verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a self-hosted deployment (Docker Compose or Kubernetes) on AWS, GCP, Azure, on-premises, VPC or air-gapped environments. In that mode logs are stored only on customer servers, so customers can control data location by running it in their own infrastructure. There is no evidence of region or residency selection for the hosted SaaS, which leaves full self-hosting as the only path to residency control. missing for 10: region/residency choice for the hosted service, explicit data-residency documentation (e.g. EU/US regions), independent corroboration.
